title: Lareina Lyu
text: I completed my undergraduate degree at the University of Toronto, majoring in Statistics and Economics, and subsequently worked as a project assistant managing timelines and budgets. Driven by a passion for analyzing data, I joined the UBC Master of Data Science (MDS) program to transition into a career as a data analyst.
